raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "employ"
  role subject "Mureșan & Partners"
  role object "Mircea Diaconu"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "employ"
  role subject "Orion Robotics"
  role object "Rahul Sharma"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "attend"
  role subject "Nikos"
  role object "the Tuesday board meeting"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "look after"
  role subject "Ms Varga"
  role object "the mail server"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be a child of"
    role subject "Alina"
    role object "Mr Zhang"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be a child of"
    role subject "Mr Lindqvist"
    role object "Bohdan"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "treat"
    role subject "Nadiya"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end

@s5 stated
  relation "employ"
  role subject "Greenline Transport"
  role object "Mr Anghel"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Greenline Transport"
    role object "Mr Constantinescu"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q5 query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject "Théo Lefèvre"
    role location "Izmir"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q6 query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "go to work"
    role subject "Ștefan"
    polarity affirmed
  end
